sloka: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः ।यदाह राजा भर्ता ते तत्तथा कर्तुमर्हसि ।। ६.११७.११ ।।
transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṁ śrutvā pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।yadāha rājā bhartā te tattathā kartumarhasi ।। 6.117.11 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana, having spoken that way, Vaidehi said to the Lord of Rakshasas that she would like to see him without having a bath.
